messages:
Priya Singh: Heads-up: Prospect LedgerOne asks for a 12mo reserved GPU proposal. Targets: steady ~120 RPS text-gen, brief spikes to ~600 RPS, 3 AZs, CMK for at-rest encryption. They want a simple committed cost + burst plan for procurement. Meeting Wed 11am PT.

Marco Chen: Quick calc: LLM-70B (4-bit) on A100-class -> ~11 RPS/GPU median (120 tokens) at modest batching. For 120 RPS steady aim for ~11 GPUs -> add 1-2 for safety -> recommend 12 reserved GPUs (target util ~65-70%).

Marco Chen: Spike strategy: reserve prewarm ~40% of baseline, keep small warm pool in each AZ, and autoscale to on-demand up to 6x for short tails. Prefer warm nodes to avoid cold start latency.

Elena Ortiz: Autoscale draft (POC):
policy:
  target_util: 70
  prewarm_pct: 40
  max_multiplier: 6
  cooldown_s: 90
Fallback: degrade to 13B model or reduce max_tokens when p95 > 500ms.

Jamal Rivera: Procurement wants a table: 8 / 10 / 12 / 16 GPUs -> monthly committed cost and expected p95. Can Marco run microbench and output p95 numbers?

Marco Chen: Yes, will run 2 quick tests on staging (steady + 2x spike) and post p95/avg util. ETA 4-6 hrs.

infra-bot: policy "ledgerone-poc-v1" created in staging (id: pol-2219).

Priya Singh: Good. Action items: Marco -> bench + table; Elena -> short pricing appendix and runbook bullets; Jamal -> join procurement call. Label all numbers as indicative until legal signs off.

Elena Ortiz: Put placeholder slide in /deals/LedgerOne/poc-docs/pricing-draft.pptx.

Marco Chen: Starting bench now, will upload logs to the deal folder when done.
